notes.title: Blockville is leaving Early Access
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, today we are releasing Blockville from Early Access, our Early Access plans didn't go as hoped from our launch and although we put our all into the game we couldn't for some reason get the traction we needed to have a successful Early Access campaign. 

This is unfortunate as we had big ambitions for the game and we were really happy with game we designed and made. I guess you cannot win them all. 

We would like to let everyone know though that if the game ever does pick up in the future we would love to spend more time on it and add to it. But we will have to see if that happens. 

To everyone that bought the game I hope you enjoyed your time in the game and enjoyed everything it had to offer in its current state. 

Best

Rich and SCT

notes.title: Blockville has launched!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone Rich here! We're happy to announce that we have just launched Blockville and the game is now available for purchase! 

It's been a super exciting process and i've loved working on Blockville, its been really refreshing to work on a different game and experiment with a tonne of ideas. 

We hope you all have a tonne of fun on Blockville and we hope to also see you in our Discord here;

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42164809/9850fb78b54fd81e4d0628877f759c358c2ba00f.png[/img]

You can come and join us right here!  https://discord.gg/CK3jAPEt6G 

Over a year ago we started off with some really basic concepts and now we have developed the game into a really nice place. I thought id drop some screens here of our early dev to show everyone how far we have come! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42164809/92fbd1de1d65c96cabd1797435172e98fafcb7cf.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42164809/9a8110e7634f86801c846893d8cb467f2b78d97a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42164809/c7c359dfcce2e962fc4d2dc73ae01889fd7979df.png[/img]

As you can see we've come a long way! In future i will make a video on this process for everyone to enjoy. 

Thank you for your support and we hope you enjoy the game! 

Rich

notes.title: Base Building Festival!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Come and check out our Blockville demo in the base building festival! We've made tonnes of progress to the game and today we wanted to share that with you all to see a sample of whats to come this April. 

This week i'll be making a long video showing that we have done with e game, hopefully doing some live streams and generally getting feedback from everyone during last stages of development! 

Enjoy the demo! 

Best

Rich and SCT

notes.title: Blockville Next Fest Live Stream!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone Richard Seabrook here! Today I'm introducing Blockville! It’s a very exciting time for us as this game is the first game we've had the time to design every aspect of and take my time in making a fun and relaxing experience. 

For anyone that knows our studio or has followed the history you’ll know we’re a totally independent studio without outside funding and this has always put me on the clock to make a game and launch it as fast as possible. One of our biggest mistakes has always been making a new game too late. But this time I decided to get the ball rolling ages ago on Blockville so I had the time to make it polished. 

Join me on the live stream to check out all the awesome features we've finished and we're working on!
